name: 100 — evidence-bound mathematical research
workflow: Choose a bounded runnable item, never an unrestricted proof promise.
Fetch the current item and compare scope_sha256 to the latest ledger.
Check existing_claims_url for a competing live GitHub claim before claiming.
Claim that exact ID and digest; obey dependencies, acceptance, boundaries and falsifiers.
Record evidence, regenerate all derived outputs and run validation/tests.
Open a small PR, close the claim, and record an honest outcome; do not self-approve independent review.

evidence_boundaries.finite_probe: Only its recorded finite scope is checked; not a general theorem.
evidence_boundaries.lean: Kernel-checked theorem means the encoded proposition, not necessarily the intended unrestricted conjecture.
evidence_boundaries.claim: Preprints and solver announcements are not acceptance.
evidence_boundaries.independent_review: Reviewer must not be the author and must assess the exact current scope.
